name: Forum Upgrades — Dataset Submissions, Global Vibe, Counters & Footer
objective: Add dataset submission workflow, globalize forum copy/accounts, fix real-time counters, slim footer, and add fun community vibe enhancements
exit_criteria: Dataset submission flow works end-to-end (create topic with flag → submit dataset → admin approve/reject)
Forum copy is globally inclusive (no Africa-only references)
All counters use real DB data (views, members, online)
ReactionBar has expanded emojis with hover animations
Hot badge appears on topics with >5 replies or >10 reactions
Top Contributors sidebar renders on ForumPage
Hermes SOUL.md has global casual style notes
